name: Modern CLI Tools
description: Installs modern CLI replacements and TUI tools: bat, ripgrep, fd, fzf, eza, zoxide, neovim, tmux, lazygit, ast-grep, jujutsu, zellij, and starship.

install.description: Comma-separated list of tools to install (e.g. 'bat,ripgrep,fzf'). When set, only the listed tools are installed. When empty (default), all tools are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (e.g. 'neovim,tmux'). When set, the listed tools are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.

jujutsuVersion.description: Version of jujutsu to install, or 'latest'

ezaVersion.description: Version of eza to install, or 'latest'

lazygitVersion.description: Version of lazygit to install, or 'latest'

astGrepVersion.description: Version of ast-grep to install, or 'latest'

zellijVersion.description: Version of zellij to install, or 'latest'

starshipVersion.description: Version of starship to install, or 'latest'
